meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成符合 AWWWARDS 级别的前端代码，包括 GSAP 动画、无空隙的 Bento 网格、宽排版标题（限制 2-3 行）、大间距章节，并强制使用 Python 模拟随机化来避免重复布局。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计网页 UI 或前端代码时触发，尤其是需要高级动画、网格布局或创意排版时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个带 GSAP 滚动动画的产品展示页。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含滚动触发动画的页面。

say.text: 写一个英雄区，标题限制 2 行，使用宽容器。
say.note: Claude 会确保标题不换行过多。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates AWWWARDS-level frontend code with GSAP animations, gapless Bento grids, wide typography (2-3 line limit), large section spacing, and enforces Python-driven randomization to avoid layout repetition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design a web UI or frontend code, especially when advanced animations, grid layouts, or creative typography are needed.

say_en.text: Design a product showcase page with GSAP scroll animations.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a page with scroll-triggered animations.

say_en.text: Create a Bento grid layout with no gaps and grid-flow-dense.
say_en.note: Claude will output a densely packed grid code.

say_en.text: Write a hero section with a 2-line title using a wide container.
say_en.note: Claude will ensure the title doesn't wrap too many lines.
